subject.title: feat(gateway): durable user profiles with email aliases and avatars

question: Should the shared-gateway identity program adopt durable profiles and the new `users.*` gateway administration API now, after the canonical-schema repair and real behavior proof are supplied?
rationale: The branch introduces a persistent identity model and public management surface rather than repairing an established behavior; the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human ownership of that product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the durable-profile phase
options.body: Approve this phase of the identity program once canonical schema registration, focused compatibility validation, and redacted real behavior proof are added.

options.title: Defer the profile API
options.body: Keep the already-merged identity threading and attribution work while deferring persistent profiles and management RPCs until the long-term operator contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable-profile phase
recommendation.body: Approve this phase of the identity program once canonical schema registration, focused compatibility validation, and redacted real behavior proof are added.
